+import csv
+import hashlib
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+from typing import Callable, Dict, List
@@ -1,0 +8,91 @@
+try:
+    import bcrypt  # type: ignore
+    HAS_BCRYPT = True
+except Exception:
+    bcrypt = None  # type: ignore
+    HAS_BCRYPT = False
+
+OUTPUT_CSV = "/workspace/benchmark_results.csv"
+
+TestUser = Dict[str, str]
+
+
+def get_test_users() -> List[TestUser]:
+    return [
+        {"username": "alice", "raw_password": "correct horse battery staple"},
+        {"username": "bob", "raw_password": "hunter2!"},
+        {"username": "charlie", "raw_password": "P@ssw0rd2025"},
+        {"username": "dana", "raw_password": "letmein123"},
+        {"username": "eve", "raw_password": "Tr0ub4dor&3"},
+    ]
+
+
+def algorithms() -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Callable]]:
+    algs: Dict[str, Dict[str, Callable]] = {
+        "sha256": {
+            "func": lambda p, s=None: hashlib.sha256(p).hexdigest(),
+            "params": lambda: {"iterations": 1},
+        },
+        "sha512": {
+            "func": lambda p, s=None: hashlib.sha512(p).hexdigest(),
+            "params": lambda: {"iterations": 1},
+        },
+        "pbkdf2_sha256_100k": {
+            "func": lambda p, s: hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", p, s, 100_000).hex(),
+            "params": lambda: {"iterations": 100_000, "salt_len": 16},
+        },
+    }
+    if HAS_BCRYPT:
+        algs["bcrypt_12"] = {
+            "func": lambda p, s=None: bcrypt.hashpw(p, bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=12)).decode(),
+            "params": lambda: {"rounds": 12},
+        }
+    return algs
+
+
+def benchmark(users: List[TestUser]) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
+    results: List[Dict[str, str]] = []
+    algs = algorithms()
+
+    for u in users:
+        pwd = u["raw_password"].encode()
+        for name, spec in algs.items():
+            salt = os.urandom(16) if name.startswith("pbkdf2_") else None
+            start = time.perf_counter()
+            h = spec["func"](pwd, salt)
+            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
+            params = spec["params"]()
+            results.append(
+                {
+                    "username": u["username"],
+                    "algorithm": name,
+                    "params": ",".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in params.items()),
+                    "time_seconds": f"{elapsed:.6f}",
+                    "hash_sample": str(h)[:32],
+                }
+            )
+    return results
+
+
+def write_csv(rows: List[Dict[str, str]], path: str = OUTPUT_CSV) -> None:
+    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
+    fieldnames = ["username", "algorithm", "params", "time_seconds", "hash_sample"]
+    with open(path, "w", newline="") as f:
+        w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fieldnames)
+        w.writeheader()
+        w.writerows(rows)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if not HAS_BCRYPT:
+        print("Warning: bcrypt not available; skipping bcrypt benchmarks.", file=sys.stderr)
+    users = get_test_users()
+    rows = benchmark(users)
+    write_csv(rows, OUTPUT_CSV)
+    print(f"Wrote {len(rows)} rows to {OUTPUT_CSV}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
+
